title: [2.8.2.2-dev] pump commands not/ delayed executed
symptom: Pump commands such as SMBs and temp basals were not given as fast as expected, or not at all. The loop did not refresh with bg change, and there was a delay before connection was established, resulting in an annoying overlay 'waiting for' message.
cause: The issue was related to time synchronization. The Dana RS pump with protocol == 5 was capable of setting time with seconds, which was not expected, causing the delay.
fix: Fixed by commit ad98bcec2eca55c25f06eb0dd123ce33081f38a9. The fix addressed the time synchronization issue.
evidence_quote: Fixed by https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/ad98bcec2eca55c25f06eb0dd123ce33081f38a9 Interresting issue related to time synchronization. I thought only RS with protocol >= 6 can set time with seconds but it looks like your RS with protocol == 5 is capable of this too
